name: shane-skills
description: Shane Skills — a curated VS Code extension that brings composable development skills (TDD, brainstorming, subagent-driven development, systematic debugging, and more) natively into GitHub Copilot. Auto-injects skills via copilot-instructions and .agent.md on activation.

chatParticipants.name: superpowers
chatParticipants.description: Superpowers methodology agent — brainstorming, TDD, debugging, planning, subagent-driven development.

commands.name: brainstorm
commands.description: Explore your idea collaboratively before writing code

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Install Superpowers files (.copilot-instructions, .agent.md) into your workspace

chatParticipants.name: shane-skills
chatParticipants.description: Shane Skills integrations agent by Shane Shou — search, create, update, and manage Jira issues and Confluence pages.

commands.name: jira
commands.description: Manage Jira issues (search, get, create, update, comment, transition)

commands.name: confluence
commands.description: Manage Confluence pages (search, get, getByTitle, create, update, getSpaces)

languageModelTools.name: superpowers_load_skill
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Load the full instructions of a specific Superpowers skill by name. Call this before executing any task to get the correct workflow. Available skills: brainstorming, writing-plans, subagent-driven-development, test-driven-development, systematic-debugging, requesting-code-review, receiving-code-review, using-git-worktrees, finishing-a-development-branch, verification-before-completion, dispatching-parallel-agents, executing-plans, writing-skills, using-superpowers.

skillName.description: Name of the skill to load

languageModelTools.name: superpowers_list_skills
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List all available Superpowers skills with names and descriptions.

languageModelTools.name: superpowers_run_subagent
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Dispatch an isolated subagent to execute a single task with fresh context. Use this for each independent task in an implementation plan, following the subagent-driven-development skill. The subagent gets a clean context with only the information you provide — it does NOT inherit your session history.

task.description: Full text of the task to execute, including files to create/modify, code, test steps, and commit instructions

context.description: Essential context for the subagent: project description, relevant file contents, architecture decisions, previous task results

role.description: Role of the subagent: implementer (writes code), spec-reviewer (checks spec compliance), code-reviewer (checks code quality)

languageModelTools.name: shane_skills_jira
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Interact with Jira: search issues (JQL), get issue details, create new issues, update existing issues (summary/description/priority/assignee/labels), add comments, list transitions, and transition issues to new statuses. Requires Jira credentials configured in Shane Skills settings.

maxResults.description: Max results to return (default 20, for 'search' op)

description.description: Issue description in Markdown format (for create/update)

issueType.description: Issue type: Bug, Story, Task, Epic (for 'create' op, default: Task)

priority.description: Priority: Highest, High, Medium, Low, Lowest (for create/update)

assignee.description: Jira account ID of the assignee (for create/update)

body.description: Comment body text in Markdown format (for 'comment' op)

languageModelTools.name: shane_skills_confluence
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Interact with Confluence: search pages (CQL), get page by ID or title, create new pages with storage-format content, update existing pages (must increment version), and list available spaces. Requires Confluence credentials configured in Shane Skills settings.

body.description: Page body in Markdown format (for create/update). Will be automatically converted to Confluence Storage Format.

parentId.description: Parent page ID — creates as child (for 'create' op)

version.description: New version number = current version + 1 (for 'update' op)

superpowers.skillsSource.description: Where to load skills from. 'bundled' uses skills shipped with this extension; 'local' reads from a local shane-skills clone.
enumDescriptions: Use skills bundled with this extension (recommended)
Load skills from a local shane-skills repository clone

superpowers.localSkillsPath.description: Path to a local shane-skills repository (only used when skillsSource is 'local'). Example: /Users/you/Dev/shane-skills

superpowers.autoSetupWorkspace.description: On activation, automatically offer to create .github/copilot-instructions.md and .github/agents/ in the current workspace.

superpowers.enabledSkills.description: List of enabled skill names. An empty array means ALL skills are enabled. Use 'Shane Skills: Configure Skills & Agents' to manage this.

superpowers.enabledAgents.description: List of enabled agent IDs (filename stems without .agent.md). An empty array means ALL agents are enabled. Use 'Shane Skills: Configure Skills & Agents' to manage this.

superpowers.jira.baseUrl.description: Jira base URL (e.g. https://yourcompany.atlassian.net). Token is stored securely — set it in Shane Skills: Configure Skills & Agents.

superpowers.jira.email.description: Email address for Jira Cloud Basic Auth. Leave empty if using a Server/DC Personal Access Token.

superpowers.confluence.baseUrl.description: Confluence base URL (e.g. https://yourcompany.atlassian.net). Token is stored securely — set it in Shane Skills: Configure Skills & Agents.

superpowers.confluence.email.description: Email address for Confluence Cloud Basic Auth. Leave empty if using a Server/DC Personal Access Token.
